Nathan Lyon to Temba Bavuma, out Bowled!! Big celebrations from the Australian players as Lyon breaks Bavuma's resistance. A wicket with just under five minutes to go for stumps. It's floated up outside off, and it's an expansive shot attempted from the South African captain, trying to reach out for the ball and whip it through the on-side. The ball dips and turns through the gate, crashing into the stumps. Look at Lyon go. He punches the air in delight, while Head - at silly point - raises both arms, looks to the skies and pumps his fists. He was put in at silly point only two balls earlier, and maybe that's what prompted Bavuma to go for such a shot? What a moment in the game. Temba Bavuma b Nathan Lyon 35(115) [4s-1]

18:05 Local Time, 16:05 GMT, 21:35 IST: South Africa end the day 40 runs ahead with six wickets in hand. They've fought incredibly hard to stay alive in this contest but Australia are closing in on a pitch that has started to play its tricks. There's sharp turn out of the rough for Lyon while the quicks are finding a little bit of uneven bounce. But take nothing away from the hosts who have shown a lot of resilience, first to restrict Australia to a lead of 100, and then to recover from those two early blows of Markram and Bedingham, both of whom fell to loose shots. Simon Harmer led the way with the ball, while Marques Ackerman struck his second fifty of the Test before he was sent packing by a brute of a short ball from Mitchell Starc. They would've loved to finish the day three-down but it wasn't to be with Nathan Lyon striking minutes before the close.
